"""Parse cost types and key figures per Produktgruppe from an Einzelplan PDF. For every Produktgruppe the Einzelplan volume has an "Ergebnisplan der Produktgruppe" (costs by type, Tsd. EUR, 2024-2030 including the updated plan 2026) and usually a table "Kennzahlen der Produktgruppe" (key figures such as numbers of students). The Einzelplan of each Produktgruppe comes from the page header ("Einzelplan 3.1 ..."), so one volume may cover several Einzelpläne. Usage: python3 -I scripts/parse_epl.py """ import json import os import re import subprocess import sys YEARS = ["2024", "2025", "2026", "2027", "2028", "2029", "2030"] NUM_RE = re.compile(r"(?[\d.]+ Ergebnisplan der Produktgruppe (\d{3}\.\d{2}) (.*?)") KZ_RE = re.compile(r"
[\d.]+ Kennzahlen der Produktgruppe (\d{3}\.\d{2})") MAIN_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(\d{1,2})\.\s+(\S.*?)\s*$") SUB_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*([a-e])\)\s+(\S.*?)\s*$") KZ_ROW_RE = re.compile(r"^(\s*)([A-Z]_\d{3}_\d{2}_\d{3})\s+(.*)$") HEAD_RE = re.compile(r"Ist 2024|Ist 2025|Fortg\. Plan|Plan 2027|Plan 2028|Plan 2029|Plan 2030") # Row labels of the standard Ergebnisplan, keyed by position. LABELS = { "1": "Erlöse", "2": "Kosten aus laufender Verwaltungstätigkeit", "2a": "davon Mieten, Pachten und Erbbauzinsen", "2b": "davon IT-Kosten", "2c": "davon Prüfung, Beratung, Rechtsschutz", "3": "Personalkosten", "3a": "Entgelte", "3b": "Bezüge", "3c": "Sonstige Kosten mit Entgelt- oder Bezugscharakter", "3d": "Sozialleistungen", "3e": "Versorgungsleistungen", "4": "Kosten aus Transferleistungen", "5": "Kosten aus Abschreibungen", "6": "Sonstige Kosten", "7": "Ergebnis der laufenden Verwaltungstätigkeit", "8": "Erlöse des Finanzergebnisses", "9": "Kosten des Finanzergebnisses", "10": "Finanzergebnis", "11": "Jahresergebnis", "12": "Globale Mehrkosten", "13": "Globale Minderkosten", "14": "Jahresergebnis einschließlich globaler Mehr- und Minderkosten", } def pages(pdf): out = subprocess.run(["pdftotext", "-layout", pdf, "-"], check=True, capture_output=True) return out.stdout.decode("utf-8").split("\f") def number(tok): return float(tok.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".")) def header_centers(lines): """Return the centre of each year header cell, or None.""" for line in lines: hits = list(HEAD_RE.finditer(line)) if len(hits) == 7: return [(m.start() + m.end()) / 2 for m in hits] return None def values(line, start, centers): """Assign the numbers right of `start` to the nearest year column.""" vals = [None] * len(centers) for m in NUM_RE.finditer(line, start): mid = (m.start() + m.end()) / 2 idx = min(range(len(centers)), key=lambda i: abs(mid - centers[i])) if vals[idx] is not None: raise ValueError(f"column {YEARS[idx]} assigned twice: {line!r}") vals[idx] = number(m.group()) return vals def label_end(line): """Index after the label text: the first number preceded by two spaces.""" m = re.search(r"\S\s{2,}-?\d", line) return m.start() + 1 if m else len(line) def parse_ergebnisplan(text): lines = text.splitlines() centers = header_centers(lines) if not centers: return None rows, main = {}, None for line in lines: cut = label_end(line) label = line[:cut] m, s = MAIN_RE.match(label), SUB_RE.match(label) if m and m.group(1) in LABELS: main = m.group(1) key = main elif s and main in ("2", "3"): key = main + s.group(1) else: continue if key in rows: continue rows[key] = values(line, cut, centers) if key == "14": break return rows def parse_kennzahlen(text): lines = text.splitlines() centers = header_centers(lines) if not centers: return [] out, cur = [], None for line in lines: m = KZ_ROW_RE.match(line) if m: rest = m.group(3) # Name and unit are separated from the numbers by two or more spaces. parts = re.split(r"\s{2,}", rest.strip()) name = parts[0] unit = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 and not NUM_RE.fullmatch(parts[1]) else "" start = line.index(unit, len(m.group(1)) + len(m.group(2)) + len(name)) + len(unit) if unit else len(m.group(1)) + len(m.group(2)) + 1 + len(name) cur = {"code": m.group(2), "name": name, "einheit": unit, "indent": len(m.group(1)), **dict(zip(YEARS, values(line, start, centers)))} out.append(cur) elif cur and line.strip() and not NUM_RE.search(line) and len(line) - len(line.lstrip()) >= cur["indent"] - 2: cur["name"] += " " + line.strip() else: cur = None for k in out: k.pop("indent") k["name"] = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", k["name"]).replace("- ", "-") if k["name"].endswith("-") else re.sub(r"\s+", " ", k["name"]) return out PROD_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(\S.*?)\s{2,}(\d{3}|INT)\s*$") KE_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(Erlöse|Kosten)(?=\s|$)") SALDO_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*Saldo Jahresergebnis ([12])") END_RE = re.compile(r"
[\d.]+ (?!Kosten und Erlöse)") def parse_produkte(texts): """Parse 'Kosten und Erlöse der Produktgruppe' over one or more pages. Per product: e1/k1 = revenue and costs of Jahresergebnis 1 (direct), e2/k2 = revenue and costs added in Jahresergebnis 2 (allocation of the authority's internal services). """ out, cur, stage, centers = [], None, 0, None for text in texts: for line in text.splitlines(): if END_RE.search(line): return out c = header_centers([line]) if c: centers = c continue if centers is None: continue s = SALDO_RE.match(line) if s: stage = 2 if s.group(1) == "1" else 0 continue k = KE_RE.match(line) if k and cur is not None and stage: key = ("e" if k.group(1) == "Erlöse" else "k") + str(stage) cur[key] = values(line, k.end(), centers) continue p = PROD_RE.match(line) if p and not NUM_RE.search(p.group(1)): cur = {"produkt": p.group(1).strip(), "ipr": p.group(2)} out.append(cur) stage = 1 return out PAGE_EPL_RE = re.compile(r"Einzelplan\s+(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s") def page_epl(text): """Return the Einzelplan code from the page header, or None.""" for line in text.splitlines()[:6]: m = PAGE_EPL_RE.search(line) if m: return m.group(1) return None def main(pdf, out_path): pg_pages = pages(pdf) result = {"quelle": os.path.basename(pdf), "produktgruppen": []} for i, text in enumerate(pg_pages): for m in ERG_RE.finditer(text): pg, name = m.group(1), m.group(2).strip() rows = parse_ergebnisplan(text[m.end():]) or None nxt = pg_pages[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(pg_pages) else "" if rows is None and "
